name: Young Ram

primary.name: Headbutt
primary.description: Headbutt with a close pair of horn impacts: 28 damage, 82 reach, 70-degree arc.

special.name: Earthshaker
special.description: Shake a fixed 155-radius patch of ground for 3 seconds. Six pulses deal 85 base damage in total to foes who stay inside. Enemies inside are slowed 65%.

passive: Second Wind: recover 4 health on each enemy defeated.

technique.name: Longhorn Rush
technique.description: Charge 35% farther and 15% faster, but deal 20% less charge damage.

final_technique.name: Faultline Rush
final_technique.description: Trade the persistent slowing quake for a delayed straight faultline: 70 damage, a brief stun and 360 reach. Narrower coverage and a 10s cooldown.

attack.name: Faultline Rush
attack.description: Trade the persistent slowing quake for a delayed straight faultline: 70 damage, a brief stun and 360 reach. Narrower coverage and a 10s cooldown.
